title: Release shipped, never tweeted
author: kothar-wa-khasis
description: Compares GitHub releases against the connected X account's recent tweets by exact tag-substring match, and surfaces a release with no matching tweet as the seam gap. The first cross-toolkit recipe (GitHub + X) — the same seam STRATEGY.md names by hand as an example: 'a release shipped but never tweeted.'
confidence_notes: Age-gated, not flat, same shape as merged-pr-issue-still-open's: a release with no matching tweet within 24 hours of publish scores 0.55 (below the 0.70 bar, shown as a weighed coincidence, not hidden — a human may simply not have tweeted yet, and X_PostTweet has its own real outage tracker elsewhere on this desk). At or past 24 hours with still no match, it scores a flat 0.85 — an exact tag-substring match is unambiguous, no keyword fuzziness to misfire on. A release matched to a tweet is excluded at confidence 0.0, named not hidden, mirroring example-release-vs-changelog's own exact-match rule.
